slug: 2025-07-16 Cameroon taps ST Digital to lead National AI Strategy (SNIA)

facts.fact: ST Digital's Douala datacentre, with a sovereign cloud and AI-specific equipment, was operating when the Posts and Telecommunications Minister visited it on 14 July 2025 (Business in Cameroon).
Business in Cameroon describes ST Digital's operating Douala datacentre as a Tier 3 facility; it names no certifying body, so the rating is the article's own statement.
The document calls ST Digital, operator of the Douala datacentre, a local firm; it names no owners beyond that.

systems.owner: ST Digital (described as a local firm)
